create_disassembler: create a Disassembler instance for a given CPU triple like 'x86_64-pc-linux-gnu'
run_get_instruction: run get_instruction on a byte sequence to disassemble a single machine code instruction
run_get_instructions: run get_instructions to iterate over all machine code instructions in a byte buffer
set_disassembler_options: set disassembler options such as Option_UseMarkup on a Disassembler instance
review_register_library: review register_library to configure ctypes argument types and return types for LLVM C API functions
